comparison.objective: Pour soup from a heavy two-handled pot into a tureen and return the pot; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated two-arm lifting and tipping of one heavy vessel while controlling contents.
comparison.success_condition: Scores transferred volume, spill, pot posture, and return to the hob; candidate scores stop angle, locking, cycling, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Heavy bimanual transport and pouring are unrelated to concentric two-tool fastener control.
